label: Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads)
terms_note: Bing Ads API guide read; developer token required, agency / aggregator access via the Microsoft Advertising Partner Program; nothing forbids scripted use

discovery.auth: oauth2 (Microsoft identity platform) + DeveloperToken header (universal token) + CustomerId / CustomerAccountId

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Bing Ads API v13: Campaign Management, Bulk, Reporting, Ad Insight, Customer Management, Customer
auth: 1. Register an application with the Microsoft identity platform; request user consent ("Request user consent for your application to manage their Microsoft Advertising accounts"); get access + refresh tokens.

2. Developer token: "Sign in with Super Admin credentials at the Microsoft Advertising Developer Portal account tab … Click on the Request Token button." One **universal** token serves every user of the application; sandbox = universal token `BBD37VB98` with a separate sandbox account (sandbox.binga

3. SOAP headers on every call: `AuthenticationToken` (OAuth access token), `DeveloperToken`, `CustomerId`, `CustomerAccountId` (`ApplicationToken` is unused). Discover ids with Customer Management `GetUser` → `SearchAccounts` (predicate `UserId`).
4. Roles: the token inherits the user's Microsoft Advertising role (Super Admin, Advertiser Campaign Manager…); "Obtaining a developer token for API access does not grant additional permissions".

endpoints.notes: `UserId`, `Predicates[{Field UserId, Operator Equals}]`, `AdvertiserAccount{Id, Name, CurrencyCode, ParentCustomerId}`

endpoints.purpose: campaigns, daily budget, status, bidding scheme
endpoints.notes: `Campaign{Name, DailyBudget, BudgetType DailyBudgetStandard, Status, CampaignType, BiddingScheme, TimeZone, Languages}`

endpoints.call: Campaign Management · `AddMedia` (image media for extensions / audience ads)

reference.limits: - Sandbox and production have separate credentials; the sandbox developer token is public. Free API. Throttling and error handling are documented in "Handling Service Errors and Exceptions" (not opened this pass — TODO(verify) numeric limits). - Terms: Microsoft Advertising Terms and Microsoft Advertising API Terms of Use accepted when requesting the developer token.
mcp_sdk: Official SDKs with `AuthorizationData` helpers: C#, Java, PHP, Python (get-started page links Get Started in C# / Java / PHP / Python). No official MCP server.

sandbox.notes: Microsoft Advertising sandbox: REST hosts campaign.api.sandbox.bingads.microsoft.com and clientcenter.api.sandbox.bingads.microsoft.com (the Sandbox URL tab of https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/advertising/campaign-management-service/getcampaignsbyids and .../customer-management-service/searchaccounts). OAuth stays on login.microsoftonline.com ('Endpoint for OAuth requests' is the same for sandbox and production on the sandbox guide), so token_url and scope are unchanged. Sandbox uses separate credentials: a sandbox customer created at https://sandbox.bingads.microsoft.com with an outlook.com Microsoft account (or Google), your own application (client) ID, and the universal sandbox developer token BBD37VB98 published on the sandbox guide. Ads are never served; single-threaded use only; limited editorial and Ad Insight data.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Application (client) id of the Microsoft Entra app registration used for the Microsoft Advertising consent.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The app's client secret; required for web apps, omit for native/public clients.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from the authorization-code flow with scope https://ads.microsoft.com/msads.manage offline_access; the runtime mints access tokens from it at https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/v2.0/token.

fields.name: developer_token
fields.help: Microsoft Advertising developer token (Developer Portal > Account), sent as the DeveloperToken header.

config_fields.name: customer_id
config_fields.help: Manager account (customer) id sent as the CustomerId header; list_accounts searches this customer's accounts.

config_fields.name: account_id
config_fields.help: Ad account id sent as the CustomerAccountId header; it must equal the AccountId in campaign calls, so pass the same id as list_campaigns' account_id.

me.note: REST POST /CustomerManagement/v13/Accounts/Search with the predicate AccountId Equals <configured account_id>: {Accounts: [AdvertiserAccount]} describes the connected ad account (Id, Name, Number, CurrencyCode, AccountLifeCycleStatus, ParentCustomerId).

list_accounts.note: REST POST /CustomerManagement/v13/Accounts/Search with the predicate CustomerId Equals <configured customer_id> and PageInfo {Index: 0, Size: 100} (list_accounts takes no paging arguments, so the first 100 accounts are returned).

list_campaigns.note: REST POST /CampaignManagement/v13/Campaigns/QueryByAccountId {AccountId}. account_id must equal the configured account_id (sent as CustomerAccountId). Without CampaignType only Search campaigns are returned; the call is unpaged and `status`/`page` are not sent. `budget` is DailyBudget in the account currency (BudgetType in raw).

update_budget.note: REST PUT /CampaignManagement/v13/Campaigns {AccountId (config), Campaigns: [{Id, DailyBudget}]}: only the sent elements change. Campaigns using a shared budget must be changed on the budget instead. The service answers 200 with per-item failures in PartialErrors: the update succeeded only when partial_errors is empty. `currency` is ignored (account currency).

pause_resume.note: REST PUT /CampaignManagement/v13/Campaigns {AccountId (config), Campaigns: [{Id, Status: Paused|Active}]}; per-item failures come back in PartialErrors (the change applied only when partial_errors is empty).

not_offered.get_report: Reporting is asynchronous: SubmitGenerateReport returns a ReportRequestId, PollGenerateReport is polled until Success and the report is a zipped CSV/TSV/XML file at ReportDownloadUrl; the runtime makes one call per tool.
